chapterTitle: Chapter 10: How do I Spend my Day? ⏰☀️
learningGoals: Understand the parts of a day like morning and night 🌅
Put daily activities in the correct order 🔄
Learn good daily habits and routines 🪥
Notice how much time different tasks take ⏱️
teachingTips: Talk about the time of day when doing activities, like eating breakfast in the morning 🥣
Ask your child what they want to do next to help them learn sequence 🤔
Make a visual timetable with pictures of their daily routine 🖼️
Praise them when they finish a task on time to build good habits 🌟

funActivities.title: My Day in Pictures 🖍️
funActivities.description: Ask your child to draw one thing they do in the morning, afternoon, and night. 🎨

funActivities.title: What Comes Next? 🤷
funActivities.description: Say an activity like brushing teeth and ask them what usually comes next in their routine. 🪥

funActivities.title: Sun and Moon Game 🌞🌜
funActivities.description: Call out an activity like sleeping or going to school. Your child has to say if it happens under the sun or the moon. 🏫
